mutations.because: The compositor must honour byFamily.size for the current display canvas. Forcing every resolve through a 1:1 spec makes a 300x250-only overlay apply nowhere — the 300x250 cell paints the base half-height and the test that names all three canvases goes red.
command: a byFamily.size 300x250 override applies at 300x250 and not at 1:1 or 728x90
